releaseNotes:
v6.0.0 — Queue overhaul, lyrics polish, playback clean-up

Queue:
• Playing a song from search now starts a fresh single-track session — the entire search result list no longer floods your queue
• Stable (non-shuffle) mode now behaves like a real playlist: 'Next up' plays your queue in the exact order, and radio suggestions are hidden
• Shuffle mode keeps the YouTube-style 'Up next' suggestions, with your own queue listed underneath

Player:
• Separate Shuffle and Repeat buttons are back on the player
• Removed the video toggle — YouTube stopped serving playable video URLs, so the feature only produced dead ends and failed playback

Lyrics:
• Fixed synced lyrics silently skipping lines that use [mm:ss] timestamps without a fraction
• The active lyric line now centres on screen as the song plays, instead of sticking to the top edge under the header

Stability:
• Inlined the playback resolution stack into the app itself — fewer moving parts, smaller installs, and a properly signed release pipeline for future updates
• Version 6.0.0 (8) keeps forward-upgrade compatibility: future updates install over this one without reinstalling
